title: Forgot Password
user_story: As a registered user, I want to reset my password if I forget it so that I can regain access to my account.
acceptance_criteria: User can request a password reset using a registered email
Reset password link is sent to the registered email
Error message is displayed for an unregistered email
Expired reset links cannot be used
User can successfully set a new password
manual_test_cases: Verify password reset request with a registered email
Verify reset email is sent successfully
Verify error message for an unregistered email
Verify expired reset link cannot be used
Verify user can reset password using a valid reset link
Verify new password satisfies password policy
generated_test_cases:
Feature: Password Reset

Scenario: Successful password reset request
Given a user with a registered email
When the user requests a password reset
Then a reset link is sent to their email

Scenario: Reset password link is sent to registered email
Given a user with a registered email
When the user requests a password reset
Then the user receives a password reset link in their email

Scenario: Error message for unregistered email
Given a user with an unregistered email
When the user requests a password reset
Then an error message indicating the email is not registered is displayed

Scenario: Expired reset link cannot be used
Given a user has an expired password reset link
When the user clicks the link
Then an error message indicating the link has expired is shown

Scenario: Successful password reset with new password
Given a user has a valid password reset link
When the user sets a new password
Then the user is logged in with the new password

Scenario: Invalid password reset link
Given a user has an invalid password reset link
When the user clicks the link
Then an error message indicating the link is invalid is shown

Scenario: Password reset link is only used once
Given a user has a valid password reset link
When the user uses the link to reset their password
And the user attempts to use the link again
Then an error message indicating the link has already been used is shown

Scenario: Password reset with weak password
Given a user is on the reset password page
When the user submits a password that does not meet complexity requirements
Then an error message indicating the password does not meet requirements is shown

Scenario: Password reset with blank password
Given a user is on the reset password page
When the user submits a blank password
Then a validation message for the password field is displayed

Scenario: Password reset with blank confirm password
Given a user is on the reset password page
When the user submits a blank confirm password
Then a validation message for the confirm password field is displayed

Scenario: Password reset with mismatched passwords
Given a user is on the reset password page
When the user submits a password and confirm password that do not match
Then an error message indicating the passwords do not match is shown

Scenario: SQL injection attempt in email field
Given the password reset page is displayed
When the user enters "\' OR \'1\'=\'1" as the email
And enters any password
Then the application safely rejects the malicious input
And an error message is displayed

Scenario: Cross-site scripting attempt in email field
Given the password reset page is displayed
When the user enters "<script>alert(\'XSS\')</script>" in the email field
Then the application sanitizes the input
And an error message is displayed

Scenario: Password reset with very long password
Given a user is on the reset password page
When the user submits a password that exceeds the maximum allowed length
Then an error message indicating the password is too long is shown

Scenario: Password reset with very short password
Given a user is on the reset password page
When the user submits a password that is shorter than the minimum allowed length
Then an error message indicating the password is too short is shown

Scenario: Password reset with password containing only spaces
Given a user is on the reset password page
When the user submits a password containing only spaces
Then an error message indicating the password is invalid is shown

Scenario: Password reset with password containing special characters
Given a user is on the reset password page
When the user submits a password containing special characters
Then the password reset is successful

Scenario: Password reset with password containing numbers
Given a user is on the reset password page
When the user submits a password containing numbers
Then the password reset is successful

Scenario: Password reset with password containing uppercase and lowercase letters
Given a user is on the reset password page
When the user submits a password containing uppercase and lowercase letters
Then the password reset is successful

Scenario: Password reset with multiple password reset requests
Given a user has requested a password reset
When the user requests another password reset
Then a new password reset link is sent to the user's email

Scenario: Password reset with concurrent password reset requests
Given multiple users have requested a password reset
When the users attempt to reset their passwords concurrently
Then each user's password reset is successful

Scenario: Password reset with password reset link sent to incorrect email
Given a user has requested a password reset
When the password reset link is sent to an incorrect email
Then the user does not receive the password reset link

Scenario: Password reset with user account locked
Given a user's account is locked
When the user attempts to reset their password
Then the user is informed that their account is locked
And the password reset is not successful

Scenario: Password reset after account lockout period
Given a user's account is locked
When the account lockout period has expired
And the user attempts to reset their password
Then the password reset is successful
